description: This PHP source file defines the ElasticSearchClientBuilder class within the SuiteCRM project. The class generates and configures Elasticsearch clients by loading configuration from SugarCRM settings, performing validation, and building client instances. It includes methods for sanitizing host URLs, loading configuration from JSON files, and providing default configurations.

classes.name: ElasticSearchClientBuilder
classes.description: Generates and provides configured instances of Elasticsearch clients, managing host configurations and validation.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Returns a preconfigured Elasticsearch client, initializing hosts if necessary.

methods.name: sanitizeHost
methods.description: Validates and standardizes a host configuration, adding protocol if missing, and parsing URL components.

methods.name: loadFromFile
methods.description: Loads Elasticsearch host configurations from a JSON file.

methods.name: loadFromArray
methods.description: Sanitizes and returns an array of host configurations.

methods.name: loadFromSugarConfig
methods.description: Loads host configuration from the global $sugar_config array.

methods.name: loadDefaultConfig
methods.description: Provides the default Elasticsearch host configuration ('127.0.0.1').

methods.name: addHttp
methods.description: Ensures that a URL has an HTTP(S) scheme; adds 'http://' if missing.
